mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Verona Community Park and a First Quarter moon phase to start our day.
The City of Verona has announced that the Zoning and Sign Ordinance has been updated, and residents can now use an interactive map on the city website to determine their property's zoning district.

There is a busy schedule today with the Dane County Farmer's Market, followed by live music events at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on October 19 or trivia at various local spots starting on October 20.
On Thursday, October 15, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I. No injuries were reported, and the department is investigating a potential collision with a traffic sign.
Today's flavor is the delicious Chocolate Volcano. Culver's is currently closed, but they open today at 10:00 AM so you can swing by and enjoy your treat.
